revision_summary:
One quote timestamp needs correction: script_coverage[5].utility_company cites 'Central Lincoln Peuge.' at ts 01:29, but 01:29 is only when the rep first asks 'Who is the current utility company for you?' — the actual utility name response occurs later, around 02:52-02:55, after the ~55-second pause. Update the customer_quote ts to reflect the actual moment the utility name is given (~02:55), or split the entry to show the question at 01:29 and the delayed answer at 02:55 distinctly, since the long gap itself (nearly a minute) is analytically significant and currently obscured by collapsing the whole exchange into one row spanning 01:29–03:12.

Additionally: (1) re-scope the empathy_miss moment at 01:37 — it should not cite coaching_philosophy.empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure since no vulnerability trigger category is present; reclassify as a general rapport/warmth note or drop the schema tag. (2) Soften the 'reactive' rep_intent evidence at 00:13 — a standard scripted opener is not strong evidence of reactive vs strategic disposition; either drop this piece of evidence or clarify the reasoning. (3) The curiosity_creation_failure moment at 00:44 should carry lower confidence given Stage 3's own admission of likely diarization overlap — consider softening the coaching_implication or marking this moment as low-confidence rather than issuing a firm coaching directive. (4) Clarify observed_outcome.co_owner_confirmed — customer confirmed sole ownership, so marking this field 'false' misleadingly implies an incomplete step when it was actually resolved (no co-owner exists).
